lines.en: Would you like to respond?
What would you like to say?
: Hello
: how are you doing?
: I'm okay. How are you?
: I'm okay too.
: just hanging out.
: In the bathroom with your shirt off?
: yeah, you know how I roll.
: I know that I can't imagine you saying that in real life.
: I'm better at texting than I am talking :)
: but I thought you said I was getting better? D:
: You are. But I think I prefer virtual Sana if she's going to spontaneously send me nudes.
: real life Sana will let you take her clothes off whenever you want too :)
: Whenever?
: I said what I said :)
: Great. Maybe I'll come back to school after all then.
: if stripping me in front of all of my friends is what needs to be done then I will gladly take the hit.
: and maybe something else if you make me stay after class? :)
: Why don't you go ahead and specifically tell me what you have in mind?
: because Ayane will get suspicious if spend too long in the bathroom.
: but you can come let me show you instead? :)
: Yeah, because that would be suspicious at all.
: worth :)
: Maybe later. I'm kind of in the middle of something right now.
: is it someone else?
: What happens if I say yes?
: I say some stuff about how little I am and how big you are and you change your mind :)
: In that case, I am busy and completely alone.
: just the way I like you :)
: I'm not really sure what you mean by that.
: nothing reallyyyyyy.
: I just like knowing nobody else is touching you >:)
: Oh, good. Another Ami.
: mwahahahahaha
: I'm bored
: Well, hang on for a little longer and I'll try to make time for you later. Okay?
: Fiiiiiiiiine
: At least you know what you're missing now :)
: Should I just expect pictures like this regularly from now on?
: maybe not regularly but whenever I'm feeling frisky :)
: And how often is that?
: anywhere from three to five times per hour.
: minute*
: Well, feel free to send as many as you like because this is not a level I ever expected to reach with you.
: liar :)
: you think I never noticed how you used to look at me when we first met? you wanted to conquer me so badly :)
: It's less that and more that I never thought you'd give in.
: give in? but I'm the one who made the first move :O
: wasn't that supposed to be your job?
: It's hard to make the first move when I'm like one step away from unconscious.
: but you were very conscious at my mom's apartment and I made the first move there as well :)
: guess I just wear the pants in this relationship.
: Clearly not the shirt, though.
: shirts are for losers and relationships are all about give and take.
: so you take my shirt and I'll take your pants and we can take turns touching each other until we both get tired and fall asleep :)
: Yeah, I'm sure that'd go over really well with the rest of the girls in the room.
: oh well. they got a head start. it's only fair if I get to do a little catching up. we can just call it tutoring.
: or maybe not since I'll probably have to make the first move againnnn X_X
: I'll return the favor soon enough, don't worry.
: kay :) don't tell me when. just do it.
: Are you sure?
: mhmmm.
: but you might have to cover my mouth so i can't scream.
: Am I actually messaging the FBI right now?
: yes, you are under arrest. anything you say or do can and should be held against me.
: Nice try. But I'm an innocent man who has never done anything wrong and will now be deleting this number.
: you'll never be safe from me, Sensei :)
: i'm coming to get you <3
: I've gotta say, this new freaky side of yours is really starting to grow on me.
: except it's not new at all >.> you just never noticed it.
: Didn't you once freak out on me for just touching your hand?
: I mean yeah but you can't just jump straight to the most lewd thing in the entire world, Sensei.
: you've gotta put it in me at least once first before we do anything THAT crazy :)
: And I'm assuming your mouth doesn't count?
: you can put it in there too but yeah. no handholding until you claim me as yours.
: I have to claim you now? I can't just put it in and leave?
: of course. but also you wouldn't want to leave because you're just like me and won't be able to hold back :)
: but that's good because I don't want you to hold back. I want to see what all the fuss is about :X
: What fuss?
: what do you think? I've heard stories from Ayane by now, Sensei. I know what you're capable of.
: show no mercy. if she can handle it, so can I.
: Sana, you are half her size.
: but three times as horny :)
: That is a very bold claim.
: I am a very bold girl.
: only in text, though. i'll keep being bashful and quiet in real life since it'll get your pants off faster.
: I'm just going to double down on that thing I said earlier about your freaky side growing on me.
: you should be growing in me instead :)
: I don't know what it is about the beach but I'm always so turned on here.
: Same. Except I actually do know why.
: are you telling me we were horny at the same time in the same room and you did nothingggg? T_T
: that's it. I'm giving you a free Sana pass :)
: just wink at me and I'll follow you wherever you want to go.
: I'm not sure if I know how to wink. I don't think my face works that way.
: then pick me up and carry me like a child :)
: I promise to be very, very good the second you put me down.
: Yeah...I don't doubt that at all.
: then my job here is done :)
: enjoy your boner. I'm gonna go play Stardew Valley <3
